title: BossHeart
description: A mode that makes playing more comfortable
body:
> If you are afraid of losing your items or your world, this mode is for you. Gain life by killing Irom golem, wither and ender dragon or install it on your own server and enjoy the fun.

## This mod gives heart when killing wither, iron golem, ender dragon, warden, guardian and elder guardian

> Killing 3 iron golems gives you 2 health, killing 1 wither gives you 3 health, and killing 1 ender dragon gives you 3 health.

## how can I use this mod?
> First, choose the version that suits you. Find the %AppData% section in the files and enter the .minecraft folder. You will see the mods file there. You can add the mod to that folder.

## requirements
> Fabric [API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) is required for this mode, otherwise you may get an error while entering the game.

## How many heart can we take from which creatures?
(This information is for 1.0.2)
> • Kill 3 iron golems -> 2 heart                                                                      
> • Kill 1 wither -> 4 heart                                                                                                                                                                  
> • Kill 1 ender dragon -> 4 heart                                                              
> • Kill 1 warden -> 2 heart                                                                             
> • Kill 1 guardian -> 0.5 heart                                                                                
> • kill 1 elder guardian -> 0.5 heart
